card.title: IPad Pro 11in 3rd Gen No Touch

claims.statement: iPad Pro 11 (3rd gen) touch circuit is very similar to the 2018 model and uses the same touch ICs (BCM15900B0); compare connector readings against the 2018 values.
Last resort: reball or replace both BCM15900B0 touch ICs; no schematics exist for this model.

procedure: Inspect and diode-check both touch connectors.
Check filters and shorts around the touch ICs.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
